success_patterns: Translate stated dietary restrictions into the corresponding restaurant accommodation options, while retaining cuisine and other active criteria.

patch.reasoning: Two trajectories express dietary needs in different ways—avoiding dairy and eating gluten-free—and the agents correctly map both to restaurant accommodation fields set to True. The skill does not state this mapping explicitly.

edits.content: - For restaurant searches, map stated dietary restrictions or needs to the corresponding accommodation field set to `True` (for example, “I don't eat dairy” to `has_dairy_allergy_options=True`, and “gluten-free” to `has_gluten_free_options=True`). Retain any active cuisine and other restaurant criteria.
